vedic_reference.note: The name Triveni is derived from the three sacred rivers - the Ganga, Yamuna, and the Saraswati. In Hindu mythology, Triveni is considered to be the place where these three rivers converge. It is also believed that taking a dip in the Triveni River absolves one of all their sins.

This sacred confluence is considered to be a pilgrimage site for Hindus, and is believed to offer moksha (liberation) to those who bathe in it.
